newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Innogenetics in 40 mln bfr cap increase.
newsitem.headline: Innogenetics in 40 mln bfr cap increase.

text.p: Belgian-based biotechnology firm Innogenetics NV said on Tuesday it issued 1,603,440 new ordinary shares on July 7, resulting in a common stock increase of over 40 million Belgian francs to 559.8 million francs.
The increase is the result of the exercise of all warrants issued after approval by the June 1, 1995 extraordinary general meeting of shareholders.

Easdaq-listed Innogenetics is engaged in research, development and marketing of diagnostic products for the detection of human diseases and in the discovery of development of new therapeutic products.
Innogenetics shares closed at $11.5 on Tuesday, up from Monday's $11.375 finish.
